stages.headline: A parallelogram's area equals a side times the height to it: S = a · h.
stages.headlineEnglish: A parallelogram's area equals a side times the height to it: S = a · h.

stages.headline: Proof idea: cut off a triangle and move it to the other side to get a rectangle of the same area.
stages.headlineEnglish: Proof idea: cut off a triangle and move it to the other side to get a rectangle of the same area.

stages.headline: Another formula, S = ab · sin α, comes later; example: a = 8, h = 5 ⇒ S = 40.
